title: Restart and Final Check
situation: Alex has finished several checks on the machine. The status light is green and the alarm is off, but the output is still low. He calls Sam for a final check. They review the belt, roller, motor, sensor, detector, cable, connector, PSU, and power switch before Alex restarts the machine and runs three test bags.
objective: Give a complete final update, review the main machine parts, report a successful restart and test, and close a technical call.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Technical support. Good morning, this is Sam.
dialogue.indonesian: Dukungan teknis. Selamat pagi, ini Sam.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Good morning, Sam. This is Alex. I have a final update on the machine.
dialogue.indonesian: Selamat pagi, Sam. Ini Alex. Saya punya pembaruan terakhir tentang mesinnya.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thank you, Alex. What is the status now?
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih, Alex. Bagaimana statusnya sekarang?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: The status light is green, and there is no error message, but the output is still low.
dialogue.indonesian: Lampu statusnya hijau, dan tidak ada pesan error, tetapi output-nya masih rendah.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: I see. Is the alarm sounding?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: No, the alarm is not sounding. The belt and the roller are moving normally.
dialogue.indonesian: Tidak, alarmnya tidak berbunyi. Belt dan roller-nya bergerak normal.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: The motor is running, the PSU indicator is green, and the power switch is on.
dialogue.indonesian: Motornya berjalan, indikator PSU-nya hijau, dan sakelar dayanya menyala.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Did you check the sensor and the detector?
dialogue.indonesian: Apakah Anda sudah memeriksa sensor dan detektornya?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes, I checked both. The sensor is clean, and the detector is on.
dialogue.indonesian: Ya, saya sudah memeriksa keduanya. Sensornya bersih, dan detektornya menyala.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: What about the cable and the connector?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: The cable is fine, and the connector is in place.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Okay. Please restart the machine and run three test bags. Then tell me the output for each bag.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Mohon mulai ulang mesinnya dan jalankan tiga tas uji. Lalu beri tahu saya output untuk setiap tas.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: I restarted the machine and ran three test bags.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya sudah memulai ulang mesinnya dan menjalankan tiga tas uji.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Good. What was the output for each bag?
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus. Berapa output untuk setiap tas?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: The output was normal for all three bags, and every bag moved through without an alarm.
dialogue.indonesian: Output-nya normal untuk ketiga tas, dan setiap tas melewati mesin tanpa alarm.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Excellent. Please write a short note about the alarm, the restart, and the test result. Call me if the output changes again. Goodbye, Alex.
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus sekali. Mohon tulis catatan singkat tentang alarm, restart, dan hasil pengujiannya. Hubungi saya jika output-nya berubah lagi. Selamat tinggal, Alex.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Okay. I'll write the note and call you if anything changes. Thank you, Sam. Goodbye.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. Saya akan menulis catatannya dan menghubungi Anda jika ada yang berubah. Terima kasih, Sam. Selamat tinggal.

keyExpressions.english: I have a final update on the machine.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya punya pembaruan terakhir tentang mesinnya.
keyExpressions.note: Final update menandakan laporan terakhir dalam rangkaian pemeriksaan.
There is no + noun untuk menyatakan tidak ada.
Still menunjukkan kondisi yang belum berubah.

keyExpressions.english: The belt and the roller are moving normally.
I followed the official SOP and safety rules.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya sudah mengikuti SOP resmi dan aturan keselamatan.
keyExpressions.note: Sebutkan kepatuhan pada SOP saat melaporkan pemeriksaan.

keyExpressions.english: The output was normal for all three bags.
keyExpressions.note: Was adalah bentuk past dari is.

keyExpressions.english: Call me if the output changes again.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Hubungi saya jika output-nya berubah lagi.
keyExpressions.note: Imperative dengan if untuk instruksi bersyarat.

sentencePatterns.explanation: Simple present untuk menjelaskan kondisi bagian mesin.
examples: The cable and the connector are fine.

sentencePatterns.pattern: The + noun + was + adjective + for + noun.
sentencePatterns.explanation: Simple past untuk hasil pemeriksaan yang sudah selesai.
examples: The output was normal for all three bags.
The result was good for both tests.

sentencePatterns.explanation: Imperative sopan untuk dua instruksi berurutan.
examples: Please restart the machine and run three test bags.
Please write a short note and call me again.

learningNotes: Gunakan simple past untuk hasil yang sudah selesai: The output was normal.
Gunakan and untuk menyebut beberapa bagian sekaligus: The belt and the roller are moving normally.
Tutup panggilan dengan ringkasan singkat dan langkah berikutnya.
Follow the official SOP and safety rules before checking power or opening panels.

pronunciationNotes.title: indicator
pronunciationNotes.note: Tekanan ada di suku kata pertama: IN-dih-kay-ter (/ˈɪndɪkeɪtər/).

pronunciationNotes.title: test bag
pronunciationNotes.note: Ucapkan kedua kata dengan jelas: TEST bag; bag memakai bunyi /æ/ seperti pada cat.
